Definition
[Parametrix for the heat operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0245 1. ch23:23.11\group Parametrix

A smooth $P:\mathcal M\times \mathcal M\times \mathbb R^2_>\to \mathbb R$ is a parametrix if $(\Delta _x-\partial _t)P$ and $(\Delta _y+\partial _u)P$ extend continuously to $t=u$, and both distributional initial limits equal the corresponding Dirac mass.
